user_can: I open my real CII model as RichInputXML in a local editor, change one column on one line with find and replace, preview, undo, and generate the CII again

real_inputs.name: GLRD-SYS-20-10.CII
real_inputs.where: the Owner's private copy, attached in the builder chat; never published

runnable: start-editor.bat (or python branch_editor_server.py --port 8766), then open http://127.0.0.1:8766/
demo: Pick one line branch in the dropdown
Find 120.000, replace with 81.000, preview the matches
Apply to the selected line and generate the CII
Undo and generate again: the bytes equal the original
done_when: The unedited round trip reproduces the original CII byte for byte; an edit on one line changes only that line's element rows; undo restores the original bytes
next_risks: hot allowables (Sh) are stored values and do not follow a temperature edit
the unassigned line group mixes elements of different lines
numeric match tolerance and fixed field width are not stated
no edited CII has been opened in CAESAR II
